story: Stage 6 of the Volta Ciclista a Catalunya was delayed after Hessman crashed during neutralisation. An early 15-rider breakaway formed, while Ciccone claimed the KOM jersey from Veistroffer. Visma–LAB controlled the peloton, and late attacks followed before Vingegaard surged 2.2 km from the finish to win ahead of Martínez and Lipowitz.
